title: The Conformance Register Is the Sole Gate for the Web Surface
context: The register for this package is empty: packages/foundry-web/foundry-web-main/model/ids.toml ends with `id = []` and states that the repository has no claims yet, and features/suites/ contains only README.md. CONFORMANCE.md is the generated register and is correspondingly empty, so the model and its generated evidence do not disagree. The disagreement is with the shipped surface: the package presents fifteen components and eleven API routes under app/api, and none of them carries a registered ID, a Gherkin scenario, or a test whose name ends in that ID. AGENTS.md R3 requires that a capability begin as a registered ID, a behavioral scenario, and a failing test before its implementation, and CM-02 makes an ID with no scenario and no test a failure of `cargo xtask check-model`. Code that exists outside the register is code whose behavior is asserted by nothing.
decision: No surface in this package is treated as a capability until it holds a row in model/ids.toml, a scenario in features/suites/, and a test whose name ends in the ID lowercased with underscores. The R3 order is binding and is performed in that order: register the ID, add the scenario, land the failing test, implement the behavior, then run `just model-write` to regenerate CONFORMANCE.md. Handlers, views, and route modules are registered by the behavior they expose, not by their existence. Because the register is empty today, the build-out series begins by populating it; no existing surface is grandfathered in by assertion.
consequences: Fifteen components and eleven routes currently hold zero conformance IDs; until each is registered, none of them is a gated capability
Every registered row carries a declared honesty level (some-true, build, or open) and a suite, so a claim cannot acquire a second source in prose
`just model-write` regenerates CONFORMANCE.md from ids.toml, keeping the register and its generated evidence in one source
CM-02 becomes the enforcement point: an ID without a scenario and a test fails `cargo xtask check-model`
This decision is not implemented by writing this record; ids.toml remains `id = []` until the scenarios and tests land
